summary: Alexander County Forest Service lookout with a residence by 1941, now listed as removed; a forest road leads to the old tower plot.

facts.design: Lookout tower with a residence alongside it, per a June 1941 NARA caption
facts.status_note: Listed as removed; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list shows it as 'Tower Gone'. No removal date in the sources read.
facts.agency: Shawnee National Forest, Jonesboro Ranger District

visit.trail_note: A trail-map app describes a maintained gravel forest road (SFR 656) that leads to the old tower site. No source says whether the site is open to visitors today.

events.note: NARA photograph dated June 1941, captioned as the Honey School Lookout tower and residence.
A 1942 description calls it a Forest Service fire lookout about 3 1/2 miles east of Thebes; visitors welcome.

evidence.supports: 1942 description: Forest Service fire lookout, visitors welcome, about 3 1/2 miles east of Thebes

notes_for_editor: No source gives a build date or staffing, so the story leaves both out. The removal date is not given. The onX page is a commercial trail-map app and is used only for the present-day road and the 'old fire tower plot' wording. A Trailforks listing returned HTTP 403 and was not used. Wikidata gives the elevation as 646 ft; it is not recorded here.
